content: Cancer, by definition, is a disease of the genes, where a gene is a small part of DNA, and it is caused by cells that have lost their normal growth control restraints and started multiplying uncontrollably, resulting in a malignant tumor that invades surrounding tissue and spreads to other parts of the body.

There is no precaution to take to catch a cold. The context actually provides precautions to reduce the spread of colds or to prevent oneself from getting a cold, not to catch one.
i mean prevent oneself from gettinmg cold

To prevent oneself from getting a cold, steps can be taken to reduce the spread of the virus. These include: 
• washing hands well and frequently, especially after touching the nose or before handling food
• covering the mouth and nose when sneezing
• disposing of used tissues properly
• avoiding close contact with someone who has a cold during the first two to four days of their infection
• not sharing food, eating utensils, or cups with anyone
• avoiding crowded places where cold germs can spread
• eating a healthy diet and getting adequate sleep.
